'''James Morris Kingston''' (born 1990) is an American insurance broker and politician from Georgia. He is a member of the [[Republican Party (United States)|Republican Party]] and the member-elect for [[Georgia's 1st congressional district]] in the [[United States House of Representatives]].

==Early life and education==
James Morris Kingston<ref name=sbj>{{Cite web|url=https://www.savannahbusinessjournal.com/news/elections/july-11-longtime-congressman-jack-kingston-s-son-leading-the-money-race-for-the-1st/article_ae992d80-a465-4f4e-ac50-51834ad9f25f.html|title=July 11 – Longtime Congressman Jack Kingston’s son leading the money race for the 1st District|first=Lou |last=Phelps|date=July 11, 2025|website=www.savannahbusinessjournal.com}}</ref> was born in 1990<ref name=thecurrent/> and raised in [[Savannah, Georgia]]. He is the youngest of four children born to former Congressman [[Jack Kingston]].<ref>{{Cite web |last=Nelson |first=Craig |date=May 20, 2026 |title=Victorious Jim Kingston awaits November opponent |url=https://thecurrentga.org/2026/05/20/victorious-jim-kingston-awaits-november-opponent/ |access-date=June 20, 2026 |website=The Current |language=en-US}}</ref><ref name=sbj/> He attended [[Saint Andrew's School (Georgia)|Saint Andrew's School]],<ref name=thecurrent/> where he was [[captain (sports)|team captain]] on the football and baseball teams and was elected class president.<ref name=sbj/><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.savannahnow.com/story/sports/2008/11/08/kingston-green-power-st-andrews-victory-against-calhoun-academy/13750400007/|title=Kingston, Green power St. Andrews to victory against Calhoun Academy|first=Savannah Morning|last=News|website=Savannah Morning News}}</ref> He graduated in 2009 and attended the [[University of Georgia]], graduating with a [[bachelor's degree]] in economics. He worked on his father's 2014 campaign for the U.S Senate.<ref name=thecurrent>{{Cite web|url=https://thecurrentga.org/2025/06/30/jim-kingston-enters-race-for-congressional-seat-with-support-from-gop-stalwarts/|title=Jim Kingston enters race for congressional seat with support from GOP stalwarts|first=Craig|last=Nelson|date=June 30, 2025|website=The Current}}</ref> He works as an insurance broker.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Nelson |first=Craig |date=April 27, 2026 |title=Kingston challenged in first face-to-face candidate debate |url=https://thecurrentga.org/2026/04/26/kingston-challenged-in-first-face-to-face-candidate-debate/ |access-date=June 20, 2026 |website=The Current |language=en-US}}</ref>

==Political career==
In June 2025, after [[Buddy Carter]], the member of the [[U.S. House of Representatives]] for {{ushr|GA|1}}, announced that he would run for the [[U.S. Senate]], Kingston announced his campaign to succeed Carter in the [[2026 United States House of Representatives elections in Georgia#District 1|2026 election]].<ref>{{cite web|last=Nelson|first=Craig|title=Jim Kingston enters race for congressional seat with support from GOP stalwarts|website=The Current|date=June 30, 2025|url=https://thecurrentga.org/2025/06/30/jim-kingston-enters-race-for-congressional-seat-with-support-from-gop-stalwarts/|access-date=May 20, 2026}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Nelson |first=Craig |date=June 30, 2025 |title=Jim Kingston enters race for congressional seat with support from GOP stalwarts |url=https://thecurrentga.org/2025/06/30/jim-kingston-enters-race-for-congressional-seat-with-support-from-gop-stalwarts/ |access-date=June 20, 2026 |website=The Current |language=en-US}}</ref> He received the endorsements of the [[United States Chamber of Commerce]]<ref>{{Cite web |date=May 15, 2026 |title=U.S. Chamber Endorses Candidate Jim Kingston for Georgia’s 1st Congressional District |url=https://www.uschamber.com/improving-government/u-s-chamber-endorses-candidate-jim-kingston-for-georgias-1st-congressional-district |access-date=June 20, 2026 |website=www.uschamber.com |language=en}}</ref>, the [[Club for Growth]], and [[Donald Trump]]<ref>{{Cite web |last=Mitola |first=Will |date=May 20, 2026 |title=Club for Growth PAC Congratulates Jim Kingston on GA-01 Republican Primary Victory |url=https://www.clubforgrowth.org/club-for-growth-pac-congratulates-jim-kingston-on-ga-01-republican-primary-victory/ |access-date=June 20, 2026 |website=Club for Growth |language=en-US}}</ref>, and was assisted in rallies by [[Jim Jordan]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Jim Kingston, U.S. Rep Jim Jordan, rally for Kingston's U.S. House bid |url=https://www.usatoday.com/videos/news/2026/04/09/jim-kingston-us-rep-jim-jordan-rally-for-kingstons-us-house-bid/89527810007/ |access-date=June 20, 2026 |website=USA TODAY |language=en-US}}</ref> Kingston won the Republican primary election on May 19<ref>{{cite web|last=Lasseter|first=Evan|title=Jim Kingston wins Georgia's House District 1 Republican nomination|website=Savannah Morning News|date=May 20, 2026|url=https://www.savannahnow.com/story/news/local/2026/05/20/jim-kingston-wins-georgias-house-district-1-republican-nomination/90172030007/|access-date=May 20, 2026}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Lasseter |first=Evan |title=Jim Kingston wins Republican nomination for Georgia's U.S. House |url=https://www.savannahnow.com/story/news/local/2026/05/20/jim-kingston-wins-georgias-house-district-1-republican-nomination/90172030007/ |access-date=June 20, 2026 |website=Savannah Morning News |language=en-US}}</ref> and won the November general election.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://thecurrentga.org/2026/11/04/jim-kingston-defeats-hollowell-in-tight-coastal-georgia-election/|title=Jim Kingston defeats Hollowell in tight Coastal Georgia election|first=Adithi Vimalanathan, Sarah|last=Harwell|date=November 4, 2026}}</ref>

==Personal life==
Kingston and his wife, Meredith, were married in January 2026.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://thecurrentga.org/2026/05/11/kingston-campaign-gets-trump-nod-amid-questions-about-ties-to-father-district/|title=Kingston campaign gets Trump nod amid questions about ties to father, district|first1=Craig |last1=Nelson|first2=Caitlin|last2=Philippo|date=May 12, 2026}}</ref>
